sentences.text: eSuunta Oy is a company registered on 2022-09-03 under the industry code 71121, engineering design and technical consultancy incidental to urban planning.
First sales are recorded on 2022-10-01 and a first hire on 2026-10-01.

A procurement notice dated 2026-07-07 from Hämeenlinnan kaupunki, titled as a request for tender for a framework agreement on land-use planning and infrastructure expert services, is stored as a public contract.
That notice is the evidence behind the technology level of 7, and its title reads like a call for tenders, so whether it is an award should be checked at the notice.
The memo applies a partner-introduction rule, but the registered industry is urban planning consultancy and the record shows no ocean use, so the fund should treat this as weak.
